The '''Naboo Royal Starship''' was a custom-built vessel used by the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] for official business. [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her entourage escaped the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] aboard the vessel.

==Description==
The Naboo Royal Starship was manufactured by [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]] with components provided by respected technological companies such as the [[327 core|327 hyperdrive]] supplied by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubia Star Drives]]. The ship was designed to be operated by a crew of four with room for ten passengers and eight [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. While the vessel was designed to operate for up to three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before needing to be resupplied, in reality it was only intended to be used for short journeys. As such, the starship lacked extensive sleeping facilities.<ref name="SoG" />

==History==
The Naboo Royal Starship was originally commissioned under the rule of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], and was later used by his successor, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="SoG" /> Queen Amidala used the vessel to escape [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
